info.title: wax API
info.description: Multi-tenant WhatsApp linked-device API. The admin key manages tenants and keys; tenant keys manage that tenant's instances (other tenants' instances answer 404). Requests may reach any node of a cluster.

key.description: wax_<id>_<secret>; shown only in this response.

id.description: Name of the instance within the tenant.

webhook_secret.description: Key of the X-Wax-Signature HMAC; write-only.

code.description: Content of the QR code to show.

client_id.description: Idempotency key: the same id returns the first request's result.

reply_to.description: Id of a message in the same chat to reply to (quoted from the stored history).

mentions.description: Users tagged in the text or caption (phone numbers or JIDs); the text should contain "@<number>" for each.

SendRequest.description: Exactly one of text, media or forward. reply_to and mentions go with text or media.

kind.description: Default: from the MIME type. Voice notes must be Ogg Opus; WebM Opus (what browsers record) is converted.

thumbnail_base64.description: Optional small JPEG preview of an image or video (at most 100 KiB).

width.description: Image or video width, for the preview.

height.description: Image or video height, for the preview.

seconds.description: Length of a video or audio (voice notes recorded as WebM get it from the file).

name.description: The group's subject, or the contact's name in the address book.

phone.description: Phone number (digits) of a 1:1 chat, also when it is addressed by LID.

last_message.description: Newest message (edits and deletions skipped), for previews.

push_name.description: The contact's own display name (1:1 chats).

username.description: The contact's WhatsApp username, without "@" (1:1 chats).

type.description: text, reaction, protocol, image, video, audio, voice, document, sticker System messages from the history are "stub:<n>" (see stub).

raw.description: The decrypted protobuf message as protojson.

sender_phone.description: Sender's phone number (digits), also when it writes from its LID. Message listings only.

sender_name.description: Sender's name in the address book. Message listings only.

sender_username.description: Sender's WhatsApp username, without "@". Message listings only.

forwarding_score.description: How often the message was forwarded; WhatsApp shows "forwarded many times" from 5.

edited.description: The sender edited the text (message listings). Edits and deletions are applied to the stored message: a deleted message becomes type stub:1 (stub name revoke).

download.description: API path that downloads and decrypts the file.

seconds.description: Length of an audio or video.

waveform.description: Voice notes: the waveform, 64 levels of 0-100 (base64).

sender.description: In groups: the author of the messages.

is_community.description: The group is a community (the parent of its groups).

community.description: The community this group belongs to.

owner_pn.description: The creator's phone number, when the group uses LIDs.

member_add_mode.description: Who may add members, e.g. admin_add or all_member_add.

data.description: Event payload; see the webhooks section.

ForwardRequest.description: A stored message to forward (marked as forwarded). View once messages cannot be forwarded.

Person.description: A user, with what is known about it (in message listings).

Quoted.description: The message a reply refers to, as the sender quoted it.

Stub.description: A system message from the history (group changes, security notices).

name.description: Name of common types, e.g. group_participant_add, e2e_encrypted, community_unlink_sibling_group.

parameters.description: Type-specific parameters, often the users concerned.

is_community.description: The group is a community (the parent of its groups).

community.description: The community this group belongs to.

BusinessHours.description: One day's opening hours, as WhatsApp reports them.

fields.description: The profile's text elements by name as WhatsApp sends them (e.g. address, email, website, description).

Profile.description: Everything known about a chat's contact. For groups only messages is set.

about.description: The profile's about text (empty when unset or hidden).

common_groups.description: Joined groups the contact is in.

messages.description: Stored messages of the chat by type.

live.description: WhatsApp answered: about, devices and business are current. WhatsApp allows only a few lookups in a row; otherwise try again in a minute.

about_hidden.description: The user's privacy settings hide the about text.
